title: Research technical architecture for Xray spec
description: Deep research into: (1) tree-sitter Rust bindings and multi-language parsing patterns, (2) WASM compilation from Rust (wasm-pack/wasm-bindgen), (3) browser graph visualization approaches (D3, WebGL, Canvas), (4) Rust CLI patterns and ergonomics, (5) performance strategies for 100K+ file repos. Produce structured research findings covering trade-offs, recommended approaches, and key design decisions. Send findings to spec-writer lead via mail.

title: Draft comprehensive SPEC.md for Xray
description: Draft the full SPEC.md for Xray codebase visualizer. Must include: (1) Project overview and goals, (2) High-level architecture with component diagram, (3) Detailed milestone breakdown (MVP through full product), (4) Data models (graph structure, AST representation, dependency edges), (5) CLI interface design (commands, flags, output formats), (6) WASM renderer architecture and browser UI spec, (7) AI context export format, (8) Performance requirements and benchmarks, (9) Testing strategy, (10) Error handling. Each milestone should have clear scope, acceptance criteria, and dependencies. Incorporate research findings from spec-architect lead.
